title: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 4 (Disqualifications)
(1) No person falling under any subparagraph of Article 33 of the State Public Officials Act, or any person affiliated with a political party, may be commissioned as an honorary Mayor or head of Gun.
(2) Where an honorary Mayor or head of Gun comes to fall under a disqualification specified in paragraph (1), the person shall automatically be dismissed from the commission.
